Your core being is self-aware freedom, already divine and liberated. It is absolutely primary and independent, therefore depending on no state or circumstance, be they everyday or exotic, nor on profound statement or ornate conception. It is the product of no means, because it's already present and never ceases. It is no special provision, no mystical attainment at the far end of a royal road,  because it's what you essentially are, as you are, here and now. It is beholden to no process or activity whatsoever, but rather is the preeminent, preexistent permission for all existences, the unassailable and pervasive freedom to live and die, and the inspired knowing that one is the deathless essence of all life. And though it is free from the clutches of thought and perception, time and space, it remains the great discovery, so cordially at home in every living moment.
